+Show Configuration
+------------------
+
+To display the loaded application's configuration as JSON, use the
+:func:`config <cli.config_command>` command. Values of any configuration key
+containing ``SECRET``, ``PASSWORD``, ``TOKEN``, or ``KEY`` are masked as ``***``. ::
+
+    $ flask config
+    {
+      "ENV": "production",
+      "DEBUG": false,
+      "TESTING": false,
+      "SECRET_KEY": "***",
+      ...
+    }
+
+

+@click.command("config", short_help="Show the app's config.")
+@with_appcontext
+def config_command() -> None:
+    """Show the app's configuration as JSON."""
+    config = {}
+
+    for key, value in current_app.config.items():
+        if any(token in key for token in ("SECRET", "PASSWORD", "TOKEN", "KEY")):
+            config[key] = "***"
+        else:
+            try:
+                current_app.json.dumps(value)
+                config[key] = value
+            except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                config[key] = str(value)
+
+    click.echo(current_app.json.dumps(config, indent=2))
+
+
